name: apprenti.dev Distributed Systems Engineering
audience: Mid-level and senior backend engineers specializing in distributed systems
philosophy: Depth over breadth: replicate, partition and break real systems until the trade-offs stop being folklore and start being something you can reproduce on demand.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
The hardest tasks in this curriculum deliberately restrict AI hinting so the apprentice practices independent fault-finding, not guided fault-finding.
The apprentice remains accountable for every submitted artifact, including code an AI tool helped produce.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated understanding and reproducible evidence, not on AI output quality.
